<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the signals in the typical aromatic region (≈110‑160 ppm) are at 143.85 ppm and 130.30 ppm. The 167.15 ppm signal is a carbonyl carbon, not aromatic. Thus there are two aromatic carbon signals, indicating two aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>2</final_answer>
